evidence.scope: Local trusted OIDC discovery/JWKS rotation, isolated audience-bound token exchange, and a strict signed-SET subset with durable CAEP invalidation including final-SSF credential-change, authenticated/bounded RFC 8935-shaped push, injected final-SSF stream configuration/status/delete/subject operations, durable desired/observed status reconciliation, bounded rate-limit-aware safe status-read recovery, a restart-safe lease/cadence/alert-state controller seam with concurrency, lease-reclaim, stale-worker, escalation/clear, clock, and tamper tests, signed stream-updated handling, durable single-use correlated verification health, an explicit default-reject/opt-in delivery-only unsolicited-verification policy with durable quota, and an Okta reference profile with a constrained, separately authorized System Log cursor read/normalization adapter; reproducible Synthea-derived FHIR R4, explicit Consent/Provenance, pinned loopback HAPI interoperability, and minimizing broker; plus single-node SQLite workflow/audit durability with atomic rollback, restart, concurrent-idempotency, tamper, and readiness tests. No enterprise IdP/STS, TLS/mTLS edge, live provider operation or approved unsolicited-event enablement, live final-SSF provider conformance, durable provider-page application/cursor state, complete event-gap recovery, deployed HA scheduler, metric/SIEM/page delivery, approved production SLO, production FHIR/SMART conformance, PostgreSQL/HA, backup/restore, retention/legal hold, external-task outbox/reconciliation, or hosted CI claim

evidence.title: First hosted continuous-integration execution of the repository quality gate
evidence.scope: Version-control landing of the previously untracked working tree and a green hosted GitHub Actions run of governance traceability, formatting, lint, strict typing, tests, and the coverage floor on a clean runner at a named revision. Closes LIM-006 for hosted execution only. Branch protection is not assessed because the private repository plan rejects it; no supply-chain, secret-scanning, SBOM, signing, or provenance control is claimed

evidence.title: M04 gate decision with durable gap recovery, deferral exceptions, and residual risk
evidence.scope: Conditional-pass M04 gate record covering durable Okta gap-recovery page application with compare-and-swap cursor sequencing and a multi-signal exit gate, the ADR-009 persistence and recovery target design, the authoritative relationship/Consent integration design, and four owner-approved time-bound exception records for enterprise identity, live provider conformance, deployed scheduling/telemetry, and production persistence. Simulated role review only; no real accountable approval, pilot, production, real-PHI, or conformance authorization

evidence.title: M05 secure retrieval corpus admission, authorization, and evaluation verification
evidence.scope: Local synthetic policy corpus only. Deny-by-default corpus admission with promotion records, second-person approval, provenance and checksum binding, content scanning for instruction-shaped text and credential material, label continuity onto chunks, authorization computed before any scoring, post-selection integrity and freshness recheck, topic conflict abstention, data-only context rendering, manifest identity binding labels as well as text, and durable schema-10 corpus activation with audited rollback surviving restart. No model, embedding, vector store, or answer-quality claim; no authoritative ingestion pipeline, malware scanning, human review workflow, or durable corpus content storage

evidence.title: M05 retrieval evaluation report with security and quality thresholds
evidence.scope: Deterministic golden-set result over a separately versioned evaluation corpus containing a deliberate conflict and canary material. Security cases (authorization, poison canary) require a 100% pass rate and quality cases (grounded, unanswerable, conflict) require 90%; make verify and CI fail on an unmet threshold or a stale report. Measures the retrieval controls, not model or RAG answer quality
